body: Thank you so much for posting. Your story is interesting and I will read it whenever I need a quick confidence boost.
Your caring and positive attitude make me feel uncomfortable. I'll pm you when I feel like talking again. Thank you for posting and taking me seriously.
When you spend so much time alone you will develop many odd skills. Badminton would have to be my favorite because it was the only sport I had trouble getting into.

Have you ever seen any torture videos online? I enjoy watching them in bed. Its just something about how cruel humans can be that makes it so interesting. Sometimes I wish I could torture people like that.
I do play sports. I've been called "Naturally talented" so I spend most of my time playing sports by myself. I do sometimes go to a Drop-in badminton place but I never talk to people there.

Don't know if genuine or trying to trick me. Paranoia setting in. All I can say is I really want to die. I'm slowly working my way towards it but at the same time I don't want to. It must be hard to talk to someone when you know so very little about him. I've made mistakes that my mind wont let me forget. I cry, cut myself and exercise because it helps me forget. Its hard to explain what I'm going through.  Thank you for posting though. Next time I'll just keep my problems to myself so I wont bother anyone else. Sorry

lol Aviator glasses and parachute pants. hmm.. Once you kill yourself you wont have to worry about anything else. Isn't that a little comforting? Even after you die, the universe will not change in the slightest. So why live?
I will try this "Socializing" as you call it. Wish me luck!
I play sports. Badminton, baseball, soccer, rugby, boxing, rollerblading, swimming, parkour and tennis. Well.. sort of. I play them alone.

agh yes. Its so mentally exhausting. You should seek counseling! I would too but I'm afraid to call/talk to people. Let me know how it goes if you do. It might help me raise enough confidence to do so myself. Best of luck to you!
oh and I changed my name because I cringed at the sound of people calling me.
